body.name: Canonical endpoint-invariance SI-PAG
body.construction: For each reported observed endpoint \(e\in\mathcal E(\mathcal O)\), set \(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{SI}}(\mathcal O)(e)=m\) if \(\mu_\eta(e)=m\in\{\mathtt{tail},\mathtt{arrow}\}\) for every \(\eta\in\mathcal C(\mathcal O)\), and set \(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{SI}}(\mathcal O)(e)=\mathtt{circle}\) otherwise. The fiber \(\mathcal C(\mathcal O)\) is constrained by the observational signature associated with \(P_{\eta}^{(0)}\) on \(U_0=V\) and, for each \(k\in[K]\), by the full regime-MAG signature induced by \(P_{\eta,k}^{\mathrm{pool}}\) on \(U_k\), including indicator adjacencies and indicator-involving unshielded colliders, even though endpoints at \(\zeta_k\) are not part of the reported graph.
